evidence.reason: The current tip already gates the dev.cycle findings-section write behind the publication scanner. In the supplied current source at src/ops/dev/cycle.ts:1303-1316, the body is composed, then `await scanPublicationForUpload(probeScanner, undefined, composed)` runs before `await gh.editPrBody(pr.number, composed)`; when no `probeScanner` is bound the path returns `needs-human` instead of writing. The comment at 1292-1294 states this is the same gate `pr.open` applies, and the catch returns needs-human on a scan/compose fault. Commit ae9eaef31160982985326562691c0ded71427fd1 (“fix(pr.open): address P3 findings on #1566 — wiring tests, fault reason, probe order, findings scans”) is the fixing change for the reported findings scans.
